newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer sees better full-yr results but loss.
newsitem.headline: Amer sees better full-yr results but loss.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said on Thursday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to improve clearly over last year, but remain in the red.

"The group's results for the current financial year are expected to improve significantly compared to 1996, but, overall, will remain loss-making," Amer said in a statement with its January-April results.
Amer said full-year 1997 net sales would total 4.5 billion markka, down from 4.96 billion the previous year.
In 1996, Amer posted a 234 million markka loss before extraordinary items and tax.
In January-April, Amer's loss before extras and tax narrowed to 49 million markka from a 114 million loss in the year-ago period.
